    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])

    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]

            rem=n-2*(dep-1)  # side length of ring/region at this depth
            if rem==1: continue
            col=cyc[dep%4]
